info.name: ASIWDP Skills Framework API
info.description:
Automated API test suite for the ASIWDP Skills Framework & Competency Management Service.

Covers CRUD, bulk import/export, taxonomy versioning, tenant isolation, and malformed payloads.

**Variables:** `baseUrl`, `tenant_id`, `version`, `historic_version`, `access_token`, `skill_id`, `category_id`, `proficiency_id`.

Aligned with OpenAPI skills-framework-service.yaml (versioned CRUD + /taxonomy/import|export).

Story: Automated API Test Suites for Skills Service (QA — Maya Silva).
Project: AI-Powered Skills Intelligence & Workforce Development Platform (ASIWDP).
